Ava: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today:
Ava: Did: landed microkernel prefetch fix (PR #432), ran microbatch perf on g5 cluster — ~5% p95 improvement.
Ava: Blocker: CI bench harness flakes, one test hangs ~30s.
Ava: Today: revert the harness change, add extra logging, pair with @Rajat later.

Rajat: Nice work. Can you paste the failing log? Also was the 5% p95 measured with warm KV or cold?

Ava: Log snippet: ```ERROR Timeout waiting for slot after 30s
  at runtime/slot_alloc.go:214
  bench-run-id=54
```
Ava: Measured with warm KV (3 warmup iters).

Maya: I saw similar flakes yesterday after the prefetch reorder. Suspect a race in slot allocator while reassigning batches. I can try a local repro.

Rajat: If it's allocator contention, a temporary mitigation is bumping slot timeout to 60s in CI to reduce flakes while we debug. I'll look at traces.

build-bot: bench-run 1743219999 completed — p95=42ms (warm), tokens=1.2M, commit=abc123 :white_check_mark: 

Owen: Pushed small harness tweak to skip network ack for local CI, PR #436. Might stop the hang.

Ava: Thanks @Owen — I'll queue the revert + harness change together. Planning to open a follow-up perf note with numbers and links to PRs.

Maya: Can you add a tiny unit that simulates slot steal so we catch this in CI?

Rajat: I'll review PRs in ~2h and run the allocator trace locally.

Ava: Cool, merged plan after CI passes. Ping here if you want to pair. :rocket:
